reason: I'd sign in with Google and run the free 15-page desktop capture on one client site, but I'm not putting even $9 a month on a brand-new tool with zero reviews this month. Mobile shots are what I actually need and they're paywalled, so I'd wait and see if it sticks around.
objection: It's brand new with no reviews. If I build client reports and scheduled checks around it and it shuts down or breaks in six months, I've wasted the setup time and look bad to clients.
would_change_my_mind: Letting the free tier do one full run with iPhone and Android shots on a real client site, so I can see the mobile captures are accurate before paying.
